Let me introduce myself, I am &YMotor &YJones, the greatest adventurer of all time ! I'm looking for someone to share in an adventure. Have you heard about the &YGolden &YTemple ?
Click below to resume the event where you stopped.
&RThanarchy seeks to collect the &YInfinity &YGems and unleash their power… in form of a slap from a giant golden hand. &OReal &Omature!
&RMotor &RJones, my grandson! Fulfill my last wish! Go explore the mythical &Ygolden &Ytemple! But first you'll need to find the &Prelic to open it!
Now that I've &Pgot &Pthe &Prelic, all I need to do is &Rget &Rto &Rthe &Rtemple!
&YThe &YGolden &YTemple? &RFOOL! This is our &GJade &GTemple, trespasser! Leave us!
Hey, is that some &Ygold I'm seeing here? Could be &Psomething &Pbig! We have to &Rdig!
Ah darn! We caused a &Plandslide with all that fighting. We need to &Rclear &Rit &Rup before we can continue!
Oh no! The &YGolden &YTemple is full of stinky &Pzombies! Get rid of them so we can &Rget &Rthe &Rtreasure!
&PZombies.... it had to be zombies! There's more coming, &Rwe &Rneed &Rmore &RSteam &RRollers!
